content.title: Appendix B — Strategic Comparison: Informatica vs SnapLogic
content.content:
**Why Airbus Helicopters Should Consider SnapLogic vs Continuing Informatica Investment**

**AI-First Integration Platform — No ETL/ELT Competitor Offers This On-Premises:**

SnapGPT is embedded generative AI for integration development. Describe pipelines in plain English — SnapGPT generates working pipelines with appropriate connectors and transformations. No competitor offers this capability for on-premises deployments. Informatica CLAIRE AI is cloud-only and lacks the depth of SnapGPT's integration-native capabilities.

**Modern Cloud-Native Architecture on OpenShift:**

SnapLogic Ground Plex is containerised on OpenShift/Kubernetes with native horizontal scaling and cloud-native deployment patterns. Informatica PowerCenter is a legacy monolithic architecture requiring dedicated VMs and manual capacity management.

**Citizen Integrator Enablement:**

SnapLogic's low-code visual Designer + SnapGPT enables business analysts to build integrations without deep technical expertise. Informatica requires trained ETL developers for every mapping. SnapLogic reduces backlog and accelerates time-to-value.

**Flexible Licensing & Deployment:**

SnapLogic supports both subscription and perpetual licensing. Ground Plex provides genuine on-premises execution with no data egress. Informatica's modern IDMC platform is cloud-first; PowerCenter is end-of-life with limited investment.

**Migration Path & Coexistence:**

SnapLogic provides automated Informatica conversion tools and proven migration methodologies. Parallel run capability allows gradual transition without disruptive cutover. SnapLogic has completed 50+ Informatica migrations for enterprise customers.
